topic: Reporting metrics by facility vs frame
summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding the calculation and display of ROTS and VAC metrics. Currently, these metrics are calculated separately for 'facility' and 'frames' (differentiated by `agg_period: H` and `h`). The initial question was whether to calculate these metrics for 'facility' (summing across all frames) or restrict them only to the frame level.

It was confirmed that, currently, the reporting is limited to showing these metrics only at the frame level. It was decided not to implement facility-level calculations yet due to data volume and query speed concerns.
decisions: Metrics (ROTS, VAC) will initially be calculated and displayed only at the frame level.
